name: gleaner
description: Gather the best of what you read into tagged, searchable clips: whole pages, collected parts, or YouTube videos with timestamped key moments, with your notes. Get a Markdown file in ChatGPT or an HTML file in Claude by default, or save to Google Drive, Notion, a Cowork project, your Claude Code project, or a private claude.ai artifact, from the Chrome side panel, the Claude Code desktop browser, or ChatGPT's connected Chrome tabs and Work browser. Local-first preferences, optional Drive sync.
